Jalen Williams: Oklahoma City Thunder star stretchered off with significant leg injury in win over Los Angeles Clippers
Jalen Williams was wheeled off the court during the closing minutes of Oklahoma City Thunder's win over the Los Angeles Clippers; Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was among the players visibly upset by the injury to Williams' lower left leg
Last Updated: 26/10/26 7:03am
Oklahoma City Thunder star Jalen Williams was taken off the court on a stretcher after suffering a significant lower-leg injury during their 108-101 victory over the Los Angeles Clippers.
Williams - a shooting guard who entered Sunday having averaged 18 points per game in his first 250 NBA contests - has been an All-Star and an All-NBA player already in his career, was a huge part of the Thunder team that won the 2024-25 NBA title.
He injured his lower left leg and saw his ankle turn in an unnatural angle in a drive with 1:14 remaining, with Williams immediately treated by medical personnel after going down underneath the basket on the Thunder's offensive end.

Williams' ankle was draped by towels before a stretcher was brought out, with players left visibly shaken by the incident and the game stopped for around five minutes before the Thunder completed their victory.
"Just feel bad for him," Thunder guard Shai Gilgeous-Alexander said in a post-match interview, fighting back tears as he spoke. "Nothing more than that."
Williams, seated up on the stretcher, saluted the cheering fans with two thumbs-up signals as he was wheeled off the court.
There was no immediate diagnosis from the Thunder, though it was clear that the injury was severe - and the stretcher was called for within just a few seconds of the play ending.
Oklahoma City coach Mark Daigneault said the team would be briefed Monday morning with the latest updates on Williams' condition.
"Our whole city will have JDub in our thoughts and prayers as he deals with this adversity and as he makes his way through his recovery," Oklahoma City Mayor David Holt posted on social media after the game.
Williams missed 49 games last season with an array of issues, mostly hamstring problems and recovery from a significant surgery on his right wrist.
"He just loves playing, loves the competition," Gilgeous-Alexander said. "That's who he is. It's unfortunate, his luck so far. But he's equipped for it."

כוכב קבוצת אוקלהומה סיטי תאנדר, ג'יילן וויליאמס, פונה מהמגרש על אלונקה בעקבות פציעה משמעותית ברגלו התחתונה במהלך ניצחון קבוצות 108-101 על לוס אנג'לס קליפרס. הפציעה התרחשה בדקות הסיום של המשחק לאחר שקרסולו התעקם בצורה לא טבעית במהלך חדירה לסל, והיא גרמה להפסקת המשחק ולתגובות רגשיות קשות מצד חבריו לקבוצה.

וויליאמס, שהיה שותף זכייה באליפות ה-NBA ורשם ממוצעים מרשימים, זכה לתמיכה מצד חבריו לקבוצה ומראשה העיר אוקלהומה סיטי. קבוצתו צפויה לקבל עדכונים רפואיים נוספים על מצבו של השחקן, שנאלץ להתמודד עם היעדרויות רבות עקב פציעות בעונה שעברה.
